explication: SayAll is a macOS menu-bar app that turns supported Bluetooth voice remotes into voice-input and Mac-control devices. The main user flow is remote input → voice/audio handling or mapped action → the active app; optional local transcript history can be read by authorized AI clients over stdio MCP. The README documents additional capabilities whose wiring is not shown in the sampled source, so those links are limited to documented relationships.
